A common crow is black.

The provided text explores the duality of perseverance and pride through the lens of *The Old Man and the Sea*. For readers who value the journey, the narrative serves as an inspiring testament to human resilience and the dignity found in struggle, regardless of the outcome. Conversely, those who prioritize tangible success may interpret the story as a cautionary tale about the futility of effort when it does not yield a concrete reward, highlighting the tension between internal victory and external validation. This contrast invites diverse interpretations based on individual values and life experiences.
